title: Amber bus route
text: Amber route A12 runs from Central Station to River Park. Peak service operates every 12 minutes.

title: Bravo fare policy
text: Bravo local fare is 2.40 dollars. A transfer remains valid for 90 minutes.

title: Cobalt rail platform
text: Cobalt express C7 departs from platform 4. Its first weekday departure is 05:45.

title: Delta electric fleet
text: Delta buses return to depot below 18 percent battery. Fast charging uses bay E3.

title: Ember accessibility
text: Ember route E5 uses low-floor vehicles. Wheelchair boarding occurs at the front door.

title: Fjord maintenance interval
text: Fjord trams receive inspection every 7500 kilometers. Brake measurements are recorded in system FMX.

title: Grove disruption alerts
text: Grove alerts use channel TRANSIT-OPS. A delay above 15 minutes triggers a passenger notice.

title: Harbor ferry schedule
text: Harbor ferry H2 crosses in 28 minutes. Bicycles are allowed after 09:00.

title: Iris park and ride
text: Iris lot has 320 spaces. Overnight parking requires permit P8.

title: Jade control room
text: Jade dispatch uses radio group J-14. Shift handoff occurs at 06:00 and 18:00.

title: Kite snow priority
text: Kite clears hospital routes first during snow events. Salt trucks stage at yard North-2.

title: Linden monthly pass
text: Linden monthly passes activate on first use. They expire 30 days after activation.
